title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing powerful new insights and tools to elevate your experience.

title: Dynamic File Management & Presentation
summary: Empower your content creation with intuitive controls to effortlessly upload, download, remove, and customize the visual display of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new dedicated roadmap page, providing a clear overview of our recent accomplishments, upcoming features, and future plans to keep you informed and excited about our journey ahead.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all while updating their look to seamlessly blend with our modern interface.

title: Seamless Collaboration Experience
summary: We've upgraded your collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work with your team in real-time.

title: Effortless Shared Content Discovery
summary: We've made it simpler to find and collaborate on shared content, ensuring all relevant items from your connections are instantly accessible when you search.

title: Unlocking Noeko: Open Source for Everyone
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with greater control and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko will now offer comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, connecting more users worldwide.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Enhancements
summary: Transform your workspace with an array of beautiful, refined themes and exciting new visual options tailored for every taste.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map: Navigate and Discover with Ease
summary: Transform your knowledge map into a dynamic hub for discovery and organization, empowering you to easily filter by tags, time, and shared connections to unlock deeper insights.

title: Powerful Search Filters and Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information and organize your insights by leveraging powerful new search filters and creating custom saved collections.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Dynamic Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to visualize and engage with your connected notes, empowering you to structure your thoughts with greater ease.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: We're excited to offer Noeko as a self-hosted solution alongside new flexible paid plans, empowering you with full control over your data and access to advanced features.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Welcome
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome message on your homepage, as we're fixing our greetings to accurately match your local time.

title: Efficient List Actions
summary: Seamlessly manage your content with new direct actions, empowering you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, and view details right from your lists.

title: Diversify Your Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring all your valuable insights into one place by directly importing a diverse range of content, including websites, videos, and text files.
